view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large warehouse interior with high ceilings and concrete floors. Red metal shelving units filled with boxes line the right side. A blue metal safety barrier with yellow base rails spans the center. A silver SUV is parked near the left wall, partially behind the barrier. Blue pallet jacks rest beside the shelves. Bright overhead lighting illuminates the space.

objects.label: silver SUV
objects.observation: A silver SUV is parked on the left side of the warehouse floor, partially obscured by a blue metal barrier. Its front end faces the camera. The vehicle appears stationary and is positioned near stacked cardboard boxes and a black plastic crate.

objects.label: blue metal safety barrier
objects.observation: A tall blue metal barrier with a mesh fence design stands in the center of the warehouse. It has yellow base rails and a yellow sign with black letters reading 'AA U'. It separates the foreground from the background area where the SUV is parked.

objects.label: red metal shelving units
objects.observation: Tall red metal shelving units occupy the right side of the frame, filled with various cardboard boxes and pallets. They extend vertically and horizontally, with white labels visible on some shelves. Two blue pallet jacks are parked at their base.

objects.label: blue pallet jacks
objects.observation: Two blue pallet jacks are parked on the warehouse floor next to the red shelving units. Their wheels and handles are visible, and they appear to be idle. One jack is slightly closer to the camera than the other.

objects.label: cardboard boxes and crates
objects.observation: Cardboard boxes are stacked on the floor near the left wall and on the shelves. A black plastic crate is leaning against the wall beside the SUV. Some boxes are on wooden pallets, and others are directly on the floor.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s3-36412", "image_size": [1920, 1080], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
